caption: The scene is an indoor airport baggage claim area dominated by a large, empty baggage carousel made of polished stainless steel slats arranged in a wide curved loop. A blue and red caution sign reading "For your safety, do not climb or sit on carousel at any time" is mounted on the metal rim, and a row of metal luggage carts sits against the far wall. The floor is a speckled beige tile, and the walls are a warm tan with a darker wood-toned band running along them. Bright overhead lighting reflects off the gleaming metal surfaces, giving the empty carousel a clean, slightly worn appearance with visible scuffs and scratches.
